profile.headline: Software Engineer at Optum
profile.summary:
My name is William, but please feel free to call me Billy. I currently work as a Software Engineer on an amazing team at Optum. As an engineer, I’m committed to continuous learning, staying current with industry trends and best practices, exploring new technologies, and refining my skills through personal projects and experimentation. Beyond coding, I take pleasure in various activities like engaging in communities, reading, immersing myself in nature, listening to music, watching movies, watching YouTube, doing volunteer work, and cherishing quality time with family and friends.

Backend:  C# (.NET Core, Blazor, Web API, MVC, EF Core, etc.), SQL, Node.js, Express.js, Python, RESTful APIs

Cloud / DevOps: AWS (Solutions Architect Certified), Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker/Podman/etc., CI/CD Pipelines, Rancher, ArgoCD

Database: SQL Server, PostgeSQL, NoSQL

Frontend: TypeScript/JavaScript, React, Angular, Next.js, jQuery, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, CSS, HTML

Other Skills & Environment: Microservices, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Unit Testing, Agile / SCRUM, Jira, Confluence, macOS, Linux, Windows, WSL, Networking and Networking Protocols

I warmly welcome new connections, so please don't hesitate to reach out.
